prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 华东区门店2024年1—5月销量 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "门店" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 92px
  col 2: header "1月" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 35px
  col 3: header "2月" · longest unbreakable word 34px · one-line width 34px
  col 4: header "3月" · longest unbreakable word 34px · one-line width 34px
  col 5: header "4月" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 35px
  col 6: header "5月" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 35px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示华东区各门店2024年1—5月的月度销量，便于比较门店和月份。","reading":"读者会先沿门店列定位分店，再横向查看其月度变化；也会纵向比较同一月份各店销量。每行应保持紧凑，让门店名称与五个数值读作一个整体。","groups":["1月至5月是同类、连续的时间列，应保持相近宽度，形成便于比较的数字区域。","门店列是行标识，需要足够空间呈现区分各分店的地名。"],"keep_intact":["每个销量数值应保持在一行。","尽可能保持城市和商圈等有辨识度的名称完整。"],"may_wrap":["门店名称可换成两行；优先将通用后缀“店”放在第二行，避免把商圈名称拆开。","名称已经换成两行时，行高可以容纳第二行，无需再为单字后缀增加额外高度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [81, 56, 55, 55, 56, 56] · table 360×394px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [79, 56, 56, 56, 56, 56] · table 360×394px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [69, 58, 58, 58, 58, 58] · table 360×394px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"五个月份列宽相近，表头和销量均保持单行；各行等高，便于横向追踪和纵向比较。门店列在保证数值完整的前提下取得了较大宽度。","problems":"门店名称仍被拆成不理想的两行，例如“南京新／街口店”和“合肥淮／河路店”，商圈名称难以一眼识别。","cause":"门店列为81px，扣除21px后仅有60px内容宽度；五个月份列已经接近容纳最长数值所需的最小宽度。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"五个月份列均为56px，数字区域节奏整齐，表头和数值都保持单行；各行高度一致。","problems":"门店名称的断行仍拆开了商圈名称，视觉效果与r0A几乎相同。","cause":"门店列为79px，内容宽度只有58px；为月份列取得完全相等的宽度，门店列比r0A少了2px。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"月份列等宽，表头和销量均完整显示，数字区域宽松且便于纵向比较。","problems":"门店名称仍在商圈内部断行；月份列增加的空白没有改善行高或数值可读性，却进一步压缩了作为行标识的门店列。","cause":"门店列缩至69px，扣除边框和内边距后只有48px内容宽度；每个月份列增至58px，超出保持数值单行所需。"}],"done":true,"designs":[]}
